description: This file manages JIT-related global state, including enabling/disabling JIT, caching compiled functions, and mapping between Python classes and script classes within the PyTorch JIT module.

classes.name: EnabledProxy
classes.description: A wrapper class that manages whether the JIT is enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: parse_env
methods.description: Parses environment variable to determine if JIT should be enabled or disabled.

methods.name: __bool__
methods.description: Returns whether the JIT is enabled.

methods.name: _add_script_class
methods.description: Associates a Python class with a script class.

methods.name: _get_script_class
methods.description: Retrieves the script class associated with a Python class.

methods.name: _get_python_class
methods.description: Retrieves the Python class associated with a qualified name.

methods.name: _clear_class_state
methods.description: Clears the mappings between Python classes and script classes.

methods.name: _try_get_jit_cached_overloads
methods.description: Retrieves cached overloaded functions for a given key.

methods.name: _set_jit_overload_cache
methods.description: Caches overloaded functions for a given key.

methods.name: _try_get_jit_cached_function
methods.description: Retrieves a cached function for a given key if available.

methods.name: _set_jit_function_cache
methods.description: Caches a function for a given key.
